summary: Genuinely mutual NDA on English law, but it contains a residuals clause, a one-way publicity right for Vedanta, and a GBP50,000 per-breach liquidated damages clause.

findings.quote: which is designated as confidential or proprietary at the time of disclosure or which, by its nature or the circumstances surrounding its disclosure, should reasonably be understood by a prudent commercial person to be confidential
findings.why: Marked or reasonably-confidential test, applied to either Disclosing Party.

findings.quote: use Disclosing Party's Confidential Information solely and exclusively for the Purpose
findings.why: Use limited to the Purpose of exploring technical and commercial IT collaboration, which is a potential commercial relationship.

findings.quote: Receiving Party shall not decompile, disassemble, reverse engineer, or attempt to derive the composition or underlying source code
findings.why: Reverse engineering of software and prototypes is prohibited.

findings.quote: "Representatives" means the directors, officers, employees, legal advisors, accountants, financial consultants, and contracted technical personnel of a Party or its Affiliates
findings.why: Representatives cover Affiliates and advisers on need-to-know with liability retained (3.2), but insurers are not listed and auditors only arguably via accountants.
findings.draft_redline: "Representatives" means the directors, officers, employees, professional advisers, auditors, insurers and Group members of a Party who need access to the Confidential Information for the Purpose.
findings.note_to_counterparty: Please could we expressly add auditors and insurers to the permitted Representatives?

findings.quote: Receiving Party can demonstrate through contemporaneous documentary evidence
findings.why: All four carve-outs are present and the evidence standard is documentary records.
findings.fallback_cited: ACCEPTABLE: Evidence standard 'written records' or 'reasonable evidence'.

findings.quote: shall be free to use and exploit for any purpose any general ideas, concepts, know-how, methodologies, or techniques retained in the unaided memory
findings.why: A residuals clause permits use of information retained in unaided memory.
findings.note_to_counterparty: Halyard does not agree to residuals clauses; the existing confidentiality and use restrictions should apply without a memory exception.

findings.why: Legally required disclosure permitted, notice only to the extent legally permissible, cooperation at Disclosing Party's expense.
Period of 14 days exceeds the 5 Business Day minimum, with officer certificate and a backup exception in 6.2.
findings.fallback_cited: ACCEPTABLE: Any period of 5 Business Days or more.

findings.quote: All Confidential Information disclosed hereunder remains the exclusive and absolute property of Disclosing Party.
findings.why: Ownership stays with the Disclosing Party and no licence is granted.

findings.quote: Disclosing Party disclaims any express or implied warranties of any kind regarding the accuracy, completeness
findings.why: Mutual as-is disclaimer with no Halyard warranty.

findings.quote: neither Party shall issue any press release, public announcement, or public disclosure regarding this Agreement
findings.why: Mutual publicity restriction requiring prior written consent.

findings.quote: Vedanta shall be entitled to identify Halyard as a collaborative partner and include Halyard's corporate name, trade name, and standard corporate logo
findings.why: Vedanta alone may use Halyard's name and logo in marketing without consent.
findings.draft_redline: Delete clause 8.2 so that clause 8.1 applies to both Parties.
findings.note_to_counterparty: Halyard cannot agree to use of its name or logo without prior written consent; please delete 8.2.

findings.quote: initial term of two (2) years, unless terminated earlier by either Party upon thirty (30) days' written notice
findings.why: Two-year term with 30 days' termination notice.

findings.quote: for a period of three (3) years from the effective date of such termination or expiration, save that any Confidential Information constituting a trade secret under applicable law shall remain confidential for as long as it remains a trade secret
findings.why: Three-year survival with trade secrets protected while they remain so.

findings.quote: Disclosing Party shall be entitled to seek injunctive relief, specific performance, and other equitable remedies
findings.why: Mutual right to seek equitable relief.

findings.quote: Receiving Party shall pay to Disclosing Party, as pre-estimated liquidated damages and not as a penalty, the fixed sum of £50,000 (fifty thousand pounds sterling) per breach
findings.why: A fixed liquidated sum per breach is imposed.
findings.draft_redline: Delete clause 10.2 and the heading reference to liquidated damages; rely on clauses 10.1 and 10.3.
findings.note_to_counterparty: Halyard does not agree to fixed per-breach sums; equitable relief and damages at law remain available to both Parties.

findings.quote: The rights and remedies provided in this Agreement are cumulative
either Party may assign this Agreement to an Affiliate or in connection with a merger, acquisition, corporate restructuring, or sale of substantially all of its assets upon written notice
findings.why: Mutual consent requirement with mutual assignment to Affiliates or successors on notice.
findings.fallback_cited: ACCEPTABLE: Either party may assign to a Group member or successor on notice.

findings.quote: shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of England and Wales
findings.why: English law with exclusive English courts jurisdiction.
